item.title: The tariff refund process is finally kicking off
item.description: American importers can now apply for $166 billion in tariff refunds after the Supreme Court struck down Trump's tariffs. Refunds may take 60-90 days.

item.title: Meet the Editor: A Conversation with Donnell Suggs
item.description: Join us for an engaging conversation with Donnell Suggs, Editor-in-Chief of The Atlanta Voice, and gain insights into local journalism and storytelling.

item.title: Sheila Foye shares her grief, healing through her short AI film Christmas Between
item.description: Discover the inspiring journey of Sheila 'Michelle' Foye, who turned her grief into purpose by creating an AI short film about loss, motherhood, and faith.

item.title: 'Beating Ossoff is not going to be easy': Dooley and Kemp host campaign event in Cumming
item.description: Former college football coach and Republican senatorial candidate Derek Dooley outlines his 'Georgia First' contract at campaign event.

item.title: Jason Esteves vows to ensure locals have control over data center development during Decatur town hall
item.description: Former Georgia State Senator Jason Esteves addresses community concerns over data centers' impact on the environment and local resources.

item.title: Registration open for BTE's 50th anniversary reunion at University of Georgia
item.description: Join the 50th Anniversary Reunion of the Black Theatrical Ensemble at the University of Georgia. Celebrate 50 years of artistic excellence.

item.title: Hank Aaron New Beginnings Academy unveils new school-based pantry
item.description: Hank Aaron New Beginnings Academy opens a school-based pantry, providing access to groceries for students and families in Atlanta.

item.title: Latryce Marie Golliday Debuts Solo Exhibition "Redemption" at Historic Candler Hotel
item.description: Discover the powerful and transformative art exhibition 'Redemption' by Latryce Marie Golliday at Candler Hotel in downtown Atlanta.

item.title: Uniteds They Draw: Atlanta United 0, D.C. United 0 at The Benz
item.description: Atlanta United dominated possession but couldn't capitalize, resulting in a 0-0 draw against D.C. United. They head into a break with a point.

item.title: Black Women Film Network Honors S. Epatha Merkerson, Danielle Brooks at Atlanta Summit
item.description: S. Epatha Merkerson receives the On Her Shoulders Preservation Award at the Black Women Film Network's 2026 Annual Summit.

item.description: Celebrating 79 years of compassionate healthcare, Sadie G. Mays Health &amp; Rehabilitation Center honors a legacy of dignity and advocacy for older adults.

item.title: What $4-a-gallon gasoline means for you and the economy
item.description: The national average price for a gallon of regular unleaded gasoline is approaching $4, with significant implications for the US economy and consumers.

item.title: Team USA prepares to host Belgium in Saturday night friendly at The Benz
item.description: Get ready for the international friendly as the US Men's National Team prepares to face Belgium at Mercedes-Benz Stadium. Don't miss the action!

item.title: Climate Justice Leaders Fight Against Extreme Heat in Atlanta's Underserved Communities
item.description: UrbanHeatATL is mapping Atlanta's heat islands to address disproportionate heat in underserved communities. Learn how they're promoting environmental justice.
